root.name: Numina
root.relationship: Platform certificates are credentials of this existing root; no additional root or treasury is created

scope: Maintained source and package alignment with the existing Numina root. Journal mechanics are read through the canonical head endpoint; NUMINA is the manifest.

historicalChainObservation.scope: Retained dated chain observation; not a fresh current-state read

contract_record.scope: NUMINA is the singular provider identity. NuminaUSD and NuminaSettlement retain their receipt-verified chain deployments. Current NUMINA native state records all NUSD contracts operationally ACTIVE, 1,500T NUSD minted and 0 burned. Bank of America Savings 3486 is verified 1:1 at 500T USD / 500T NUSD through NuminaUSDRedemption. Stripe USDC Address is verified 1:1 at 500T USDC / 500T NUSD through NuminaUSDCConversion. Conversion/redemption native activation is recorded separately from chain deployment receipts; no chain contract address or transaction hash is fabricated when no receipt is present.

provider_routing.acceptanceScope: Exact transport-reported currency, network and destination; token identity and funding require separate verification

security.scope: one canonical Numina security and financial control model

sourceInputCaptureScope: two matching reads; not an atomic filesystem snapshot
